title: Uwo Mugambi Yitwikiriye
intro: Usanga uri imbere y’umuntu w’ububasha wo mu misi y’ivyahishuriwe. Uwo muntu yari azwi kubera ubwenge bwiwe, ubutunzi bwiwe n’ikibanza yari afise mu bantu biwe. Igihe ibimenyetso bigaragara vyaza, baramenye ubwiza ariko bahisemwo gutera umugongo aho kuyoboka. Ni igiki catumye uwo mutima ugira umugambi mu mwiza, kandi ni igiki cabashikiye?
clues: Narahezagiwe n’ubutunzi bwinshi be n’ububasha bwinshi, bituma ijambo ryanje riremerera mu makoraniro.
Igihe amajambo y’ubumana yasomwa, sinari gushobora guhakana ubuhinga bwabo bwo kuvuga, ariko ubwibone bwanje ntibwari kunyemerera kuyoboka.
Nakoranije abajanama banje, nditandukanya n’abandi kugira ngo nzirikane uburyo bwo gusenyura ubutumwa.
Nahejeje kwiyumvira cane, nta kindi namenyesheje atari ‘ubupfumu bwavuye muri kahise’ bwo guhindura abantu.
Iryo hishurwa rero ryarambwiye ata guca ku ruhande riti: 'Nsige n'uwo naremye jenyene.' Naratowe kubera umugambi wanje.
Vuba, uwo muriro nyene nagabishijwe uzompagarika ku rubavu, nta n’aho nzoba nshobora guhunga.
